paper.title: Algorithm 785: A software package for computing Schwarz-Christoffel conformal transformation for doubly connected polygonal regions

stack: Fortran 77 (TOMS 785 archive 785.gz: Fortran77/Src/Dp/src.f, Fortran77/Drivers/Dp/driver.f and data, shipped transcript Fortran77/Drivers/Dp/RES)

claim.text: Registered as example 6 (referee example, NPTQ=7, TOL=0.1E-09) of the shipped RES transcript: U = 0.4559381277686, C = (1.8134230823216, -1.8134230823303), absolute tolerance 1e-7.

attempt: Blocked: the claim is mis-specified. The registered numbers are not example 6 of the shipped transcript. They are the first example block (problem 1: menu item 1, square-symmetric region, NPTQ=7, M=4, N=4). The authors' unedited driver, compiled with gfortran -std=legacy, ran the archive's own data file as its keyboard stream and printed all seven example blocks. Block 1 matches the registered U and C exactly (to the printed 13 digits). Block 6, the referee example that the claim names, gives U = 0.1772675789993 and C = (-0.7515041412251, 1.2077109426967), which is far outside the registered tolerance (the transcript shows the same U = 0.1772675790003). Blocks 2, 3 and 6 differ from the transcript's printed values at 1e-8 to 1e-7 in the last digits; blocks 1, 4, 5 and 7 are exact. The claim and tolerance were not changed. The scout chooses the fix: re-register as example 1, or as example 6 with its own values, see reports/hu1998-schwarzchristoffel-785/note-to-scout.md.

original_attempt.reason: The archive's unedited driver.f and src.f compiled with gfortran -std=legacy (compile_exit=0), and the full session (the archive's data file as stdin) ran to completion with exit 0, printing seven example blocks.
